plugin_install.agents.revert_plan: undoes what `install --agents` wrote in {n} subagent(s), as the installation state records it
plugin_install.desktop.plan: `local-delegate` entry of the Claude Desktop chat (`desktop-bridge`) in {path}
plugin_install.desktop.replaced_foreign: There was a `local-delegate` entry that `install` did not write; it was replaced because `--desktop` asked for it. The old one is in the copy {backup}; if it held a written token, delete it.
plugin_install.desktop.up_to_date: The bridge entry was already up to date.
plugin_install.desktop.written: Bridge entry written. Restart Claude Desktop so it loads it.
plugin_install.failed: The plugin delivery stopped at the «{step}» step.
plugin_install.kept: Claude Code has the plugin installed and it cannot be used now; it is left as it is and no hooks are registered in settings.json (they would be duplicates). {warning}
plugin_install.plan: Claude Code by plugin: {plugin} {version} (claude {claude}); removes the settings.json hooks after checking the plugin
plugin_install.read_switch.off_plan: turns off the active layer of the read hook (`read-hook.json`)
plugin_install.read_switch.on_plan: turns on the active layer of the read hook (`read-hook.json`)
plugin_install.revert_plan: Claude Code goes back to the settings delivery: uninstalls the plugin and registers the hooks in settings.json
plugin_install.revert_without_cli: `claude` was not found on the PATH: without it the plugin cannot be uninstalled, so settings is not restored (the hooks would be duplicated).
plugin_install.uninstall.desktop_backup: The entry that existed before `install --desktop` is not restored (it could hold the token). It is in the copy {backup}.
plugin_install.uninstall.desktop_plan: removes the `local-delegate` entry of the Claude Desktop chat
plugin_install.uninstall.no_cli: `claude` was not found on the PATH: the plugin could not be uninstalled.
plugin_install.uninstall.plugin_plan: uninstalls the Claude Code plugin {plugin} (and its marketplace, if `install` added it)
